data.name: Susanto
data.gender_notes: Susanto is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has abundance, prosperity and is blessed with good fortune. The name Susanto carries the meaning “Blessed with good fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Susanto usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with good fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to those who are blessed with the grace of the gods
data.etymology: Susanto belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed with good fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Susanto total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_sanskrit.name: सुसन्तो
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सुसु (su-su) meaning good or auspicious and अन्तो (anto) meaning end or limit. Hence, Susanto means 'having good or auspicious qualities up to the end or limit'. It is also interpreted as 'having good or auspicious qualities in all aspects'.

in_hindi.name: सुसन्तो
in_hindi.long_meaning: शुभ (shubh) meaning good or auspicious and गुण (gun) meaning qualities. Hence, Susanto in Hindi means 'having good or auspicious qualities'.

in_tamil.name: சுசந்தோ
in_tamil.long_meaning: சுசு (cucu) meaning good or auspicious and ந்தோ (ndho) meaning end or limit. Hence, Susanto in Tamil means 'having no bad qualities up to the end'.

in_telugu.name: శుశంటో
in_telugu.long_meaning: శుశీ (shushi) meaning good or auspicious and కర్యపూర్ణ (kar-yapurnam) meaning work or action. Hence, Susanto in Telugu means 'having good or auspicious qualities in work or actions'.
